integrity: The universal proof is analytic. The numerical verifier is a finite consistency check and is not used as proof of the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to coordinatewise nonvanishing signals, odd \(d\), \(L<d/2\), and \(\gcd(d,L)=1\).
The condition is sufficient rather than necessary and no stability estimate is proved.
A 2026 related preprint was available only at abstract level for comparison and remains a residual literature risk.
title: Endpoint-lag recovery for nonvanishing cyclic STFT phase retrieval
